empty.title: No instances yet
empty.hint: An instance is a separate Minecraft installation with its own mods, worlds and settings.

selection.none: Select an instance to see actions
selection.playSoon: Launching the game arrives in stage 3
selection.deleteBody: The instance “{{name}}” with its worlds, mods and settings will be moved to the trash.

groupDialog.title: Instance group
groupDialog.hint: Pick an existing group or type a new one. Leave empty to remove from group.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartRequired: The new data folder will be used after restarting the launcher. Files are not moved automatically.

general.dataDirHint: Instances, libraries, assets and settings are stored here.
general.portable: Portable mode: the data folder is next to the program.
general.msaClientIdHint: Required for Microsoft sign-in: an Azure app (public client, device code flow) approved by Mojang for the Minecraft API. Empty — use the one built in at compile time.
general.msaClientIdBuiltIn: A Client ID is built in — this field can stay empty.

java.pathHint: Detecting and testing installed JVMs arrives in stage 3.

game.onLaunchHide: Hide the launcher until the game exits
game.showLog: Open the log when the game starts

network.passwordHint: The proxy password will be kept in the system secret store (stage 4).
network.maxJobsHint: How many installs, modpacks and Java downloads run in parallel; the rest wait in the queue.

about.disclaimer: Cubelaunch is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. Game files are downloaded only from official servers.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.offlineWarning: An offline account is not licensed: it works for singleplayer and servers without license checks. Official servers and skins are unavailable.
accounts.msaStep1: Open the Microsoft sign-in page and enter the code:
accounts.codeExpires: The code is valid for {{min}} min.
accounts.msaHint: You can keep this window open — the launcher continues once you confirm in the browser.
accounts.msaNotConfigured: Microsoft sign-in is not configured: set the Azure app Client ID in Settings (General). See the README for how to get one.

stage.waiting: Waiting for confirmation in the browser…

game.notStarted: The game has not been launched since the launcher opened.

overrides.intro: These settings apply only to this instance and replace the global ones. Unchecked ones come from the global settings.
overrides.commandsHint: Available variables: INST_NAME, INST_ID, INST_DIR, INST_MC_DIR, INST_MC_VERSION, INST_JAVA. If the pre-launch command fails, the game does not start.

javaSettings.downloadHint: Java is downloaded from Adoptium (Eclipse Temurin) into the launcher folder. Minecraft 1.16 and older — Java 8, 1.17–1.20.4 — Java 17, 1.20.5+ — Java 21, newer versions may need Java 25.
javaSettings.memoryHint: The system has {{total}} RAM. Up to {{rec}} is recommended for vanilla.
javaSettings.memoryTooHigh: Too much: leave at least 2 GB for the system

errors.title: Error
errors.io: Could not read or write a file
errors.json: A data file is corrupted or has an invalid format
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and proxy settings.
errors.checksum: A downloaded file is corrupted: checksum mismatch
errors.java_invalid: The selected Java does not work
errors.keyring: The system password store is unavailable. On Linux, install and run gnome-keyring or KWallet.
errors.auth_not_configured: Microsoft sign-in is not configured: an Azure app Client ID is required
errors.auth_declined: Sign-in was declined in the browser
errors.auth_code_expired: The sign-in code expired — start again
errors.auth_no_xbox: This account has no Xbox profile. Create one at xbox.com and try again
errors.auth_country_blocked: Xbox Live is not available in the account's country
errors.auth_adult_verification: This account needs age verification at xbox.com
errors.auth_child_account: A child account needs adult permission in the Microsoft family group
errors.auth_app_not_approved: This app is not approved by Mojang for the Minecraft API (403). Apply for your Client ID
errors.auth_no_game: This account does not own Minecraft: Java Edition (or has no game profile yet)
errors.auth_relogin: The account session expired — sign in again
errors.loader: Could not install the mod loader

changeVersion.title: Version of “{{name}}”
changeVersion.warnVersion: Changing the Minecraft version keeps mods, resource packs and worlds, but they may be incompatible. Back up your worlds.
changeVersion.warnLoader: Mods for another loader will not work and need replacing. Worlds and settings are kept.

content.needLoader: Mods need a mod loader (Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge). Choose one on the Version tab.
content.emptyHint: Find them on Modrinth or drop files into this window.
content.incompatibleHint: Mod for: {{loaders}}. It will not load in this instance.
content.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be moved to the recycle bin.

modrinth.title: {{source}}: {{kind}} for {{target}}
modrinth.nothing: Nothing found for this game version
modrinth.noCompatible: No versions compatible with this instance
modrinth.notice: Only projects compatible with the game version and loader of the instance are shown. Files are downloaded from {{source}} servers.

worlds.runningHint: The game is running: deleting is disabled, and a backup may miss the latest changes (the game saves periodically).
worlds.empty: No worlds yet — they appear after you play.
worlds.deleteBody: World “{{name}}” will be moved to the recycle bin, where it can be restored.
worlds.deleted: World “{{name}}” moved to the recycle bin

curseforge.notConfigured: CurseForge needs an API key. Get one at console.curseforge.com and enter it in settings.
curseforge.keyHint: Required to search and install from CurseForge and for CurseForge modpacks. The key is kept in the system secret store.
curseforge.keyBuiltIn: Using the key built into this build.

modpacks.notice: A modpack is installed as a new instance. Files come from {{source}} and mod authors' servers.
modpacks.importHint: .mrpack (Modrinth), CurseForge .zip or an instance zip (Cubelaunch, Prism Launcher, MultiMC). You can also drop it onto the instance list.
modpacks.cfNeedsKey: Mods of this pack are downloaded through the CurseForge API — a key is required in settings.
modpacks.updateHint: Updating replaces pack files and removes ones dropped from the pack. Your own mods and configs you changed are kept.
modpacks.missingHint: Authors disallowed third-party launchers for these files. Download them from CurseForge into your Downloads folder and press “Check” — the launcher will find them.
modpacks.dropOnlyPacks: Drop a modpack or instance zip here

export.title: Export “{{name}}”
export.started: Export started — the file appears when the task finishes
export.mrpackHint: Mods, resource packs and shaders from Modrinth are written as links, everything else goes to overrides.
export.cfHint: Mods from CurseForge are written as links (by file fingerprint), everything else goes to overrides.
export.cfNoKey: No CurseForge key — all files will go to overrides.
export.name: Name
export.includeHint: Logs, screenshots and crash reports are never exported. Disabled mods are skipped.

downloads.title: Download center
downloads.maxJobsHint: How many download tasks run in parallel (Network settings)

groups.dragHint: Drag to reorder; right-click to rename or delete
groups.renameHint: If a group with this name exists, the groups are merged.
groups.deleteBody: Group “{{name}}” will be deleted; its instances become ungrouped.

clone.title: Clone “{{name}}”
clone.hint: Mods, configs, resource packs and instance settings are copied. Playtime is not.

instanceExport.title: Export instance “{{name}}”
instanceExport.hint: The whole instance is saved to a zip: settings, mods, configs, worlds. Game files are not included — they are downloaded from Mojang after import.
instanceExport.includeHint: Logs and crash reports are never exported. Java path and playtime are not saved.

instanceImport.hint: The whole instance is imported. Game and loader files are downloaded from official servers.

updates.title: Updates
updates.blockedGame: Close the game to install the update
updates.blockedJobs: Wait for downloads and other tasks to finish

manual.portable: Portable mode: download the new version manually.
manual.unpackaged: Not installed by the installer: download the new version manually.
